Once a prison camp during WWII, Eden Camp is now a museum housing many an artefact and many a ghost. Karl enters the cottage to face the spirits that are said to haunt this once family home.
Once a grand mansion, this huge property is now very much passed it previous grandeur. Stuart investigates the long empty corridors alone and something seems to be following him.

NFL great, Eric Dickerson fears that there are spirits in his Calabasas, California home tormenting his children.

The upper floors of Margam Castle are said to be haunted by many different spirits, Stuart goes it alone to try and find them.

Said to be the Most Haunted prison in the UK, HMP Dorchester is a scary place to be with a group of people but alone it becomes terrifying. Karl investigates the upper cells and gets more than he bargained for.

With a history dating back to 1185, Salmesbury Hall is of the UK’s most historic buildings and said to be one of the most haunted. With ghost stories and sightings all over the building, Stuart investigates the ground floor.
Karl investigates the upper floors of this historic building dating back to 1185, and realises he is not alone.

Stuart investigates two buildings, a forge and the cottage. He could not have imagined the activity that unfolded around him.
Stuart investigates the main house and seems to be pulled in different directions from an unexplained energy.
